Thane court gives life sentence for wife's murder

A court in Thane has sentenced a man to life imprisonment for the murder of his wife. The verdict was delivered by the Thane court, concluding the legal proceedings in the case. This sentencing marks the final judgment in the domestic violence and murder trial.
